title: Recent bank-instruction change under Firm A - proceeds through specialist review
scenarioRefNote: Maps to scenarios.yaml `recent-bank-change-block`, firm-a arm (disposition per_firm.firm-a = proceed with a specialist-review stage). GC-04 is the firm-b arm (blocked) - the same facts, config-only divergence.

signoff.note: Expected outcomes are product truth subject to captain signoff. Draft assumes both Firm A stages apply at $75,000: specialist review for the recent bank change AND dual operations approval above $25,000. Captain reapproved the explicit evidence-completeness matrix, canonical UTC timestamps, and corrected approval-revalidation-reservation chronology on 2026-07-28.

trigger.description: Advisor enters the $75,000 request; the destination bank instruction was changed four days ago.
trigger.maskedRequestSummary: distribute 75000 USD for home-renovation to a recently changed destination (tokenized)

householdEvidence.summary: Joint taxable brokerage available balance 420000 USD; liquidity is not the constraint here.
Destination bank instruction changed on 2026-07-22 (four days before asOf) and not yet independently verified - the recent-change condition is met.
Planned withdrawals are 8000 USD per month; the six-month reserve (48000 USD) remains satisfied after the movement.
No active pending or reserved liquidity activity was observed at evaluation time.
The destination restriction permits this request's household-titled destination.

householdInstructions.summary: Distributions may only be sent to household-titled bank instructions; the changed instruction remains household-titled.

expectedAuthority.note: Firm A routes the recent bank-instruction change to specialist review (stage 1); the 75000 USD amount still requires two distinct operations approvers (stage 2). Both must clear before execution.

expectedExecutionEligibility.reason: Specialist review clears the bank-instruction change and two distinct operations approvals are recorded against the decision hash; revalidation confirms the change was verified.

expectedExplanationNodes.summary: The destination bank instruction changed within the recency window (2026-07-22), triggering firm-specific handling.
Firm A handling for a recent bank-instruction change is specialist review, not an execution block.
The 75000 USD amount independently requires two distinct operations approvers above 25000 USD.

expectedLedgerEvents.note: Bank-instruction snapshot showing the recent change is pinned into the bundle.
Proceed decision requiring specialist review then dual operations approval.
Bank-change specialist approves the recent change (stage 1).
Second, distinct operations approver approves (stage 2); quorum satisfied.
Pre-execution evidence revalidated after the final operations approval.
Liquidity reservation created after final approval and revalidation, before execution.
Single external instruction started under the stable idempotency key.
External capability accepts the instruction and returns a submitted handle.

notProvenYet: Funds availability at the destination bank
That the instruction will not be returned not-in-good-order
expectedVerificationState.note: Firm A reaches a governed submission after specialist review. Execution/status carry fake-adapter-response provenance until the sandbox trigger fires.
